verdict.rationale: Intel's marketing pages say Arc integrated graphics and XeSS 3 deliver 'ultra-smooth FPS on the go,' list support for thousands of AAA and indie titles across major storefronts, and mention FPS-boosting optimization tools. These are vendor-only, generic Core Ultra claims, with nothing specific to the 258V and no numbers. Missing for 10: independent game benchmarks or frame-rate data, specific cache and boost-clock claims, 258V-specific integrated GPU specs, and any hands-on corroboration of the gaming claims.
